text: 金十数据11月12日讯，*ST卓然公告，公司近日收到上海市黄浦区人民法院送达的传票、《民事起诉状》及相关材料，上海农村商业银行股份有限公司黄浦支行就供应链保理合同纠纷，将公司及两家全资子公司卓然(靖江)设备制造有限公司、上海卓然数智能源有限公司列为共同被告提起民事诉讼，法院已立案受理，尚未开庭审理。原告诉请判令公司支付供应链保理融资本金合计人民币8011.79万元，并以该本金为基数按约定融资利率上浮50%计算逾期利息至实际清偿之日止。原告称2025年6-12月以无追索权保理方式受让部分供应商对三被告的应收账款，涉及本金合计8011.79万元，后部分保理业
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 12: *ST Zhuoran announced that the company recently received a summons, a Civil Complaint and related materials served by the Huangpu District People's Court of Shanghai. Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. Huangpu Branch filed a civil lawsuit over a supply chain factoring contract dispute, naming the company and its two wholly-owned subsidiaries Zhuoran (Jingjiang) Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and Shanghai Zhuoran Digital Intelligent Energy Co., Ltd. as co-defendants. The court has accepted the case and has not yet held a hearing. The plaintiff requests an order that the company pay a total supply chain factoring financing principal of RMB 80,117,900, and that overdue interest be calculated on that principal at the agreed financing rate plus 50% until actual repayment.
